name: [🗺️MAP] Welcome to Bloxburg
description:
👋 Welcome to the town of Bloxburg, where you can be anything you want to be!

🏡 Build and decorate, or buy the house or creation of your dreams!
👕 Customize your character with outfits and roles!
🎭 Roleplay with friends using interactive items and emotes! 
💼 Choose a job and earn money + rewards as you work!

🏆 Level up your skills, such as cooking, and unlock exciting content!

Thanks for playing! Make sure to follow us ⭐ and give the game a thumbs up! 👍

name: Shrink Hide & Seek
description:
Shrink Hide & Seek is a combination of hide and seek and the ability to shrink! 

🤏 AS HIDER: Shrink and hide inside objects. Use powers and trolls to distract the seekers. DON’T GET CAUGHT!
👀 AS SEEKER: Try to find the hiders and kill them. Once you kill them they’ll join your team. FIND ALL HIDERS!

💰 Collect coins to get better powers and weapons!

name: Steal A Fish!
description:
🐟 Collect powerful fish and earn Money!

👣 Sneak into enemy bases and steal their Fish!

🎭 Welcome to Steal a Fish 🎭

[How to Play]
• Buy fish that appear through the tunnel
• Add them to your collection to generate Money
• Visit other players to see their fish stash

name: MX WORLD [In Dev]
description:
This MX Racing & Free-Roam experience is in a very early public alpha-testing phase and remains under active development. You may encounter significant bugs, missing features, and performance issues. All in-game progress and saved data are temporary and will be reset upon official launch when a permanent data system is implemented. Feedback and suggestions will be gathered at release to guide future updates.

Ride freely on dirt bikes, ATVs, and UTVs—and thanks for helping us build the best off-road world!

All in-game brands are fictional and not affiliated with any real company.
All in-game stunts and maneuvers are purely fictional—do not attempt to replicate them in real life.
In real life, ride safely with proper safety gear and precautions.
